title: Lock&lock rectangular
text: Lock&lock rectangular. Of all the airtight containers I've purchased, I like this brand the best.  Easiest to wash... easiest to use... I purchased a number of different sizes and find them useful for more than just food storage. I use the one with the handle to hold my sewing kit. ALSO...
